title: Sundowns face Milford in Betway Premiership
seoTitle: Sundowns face Milford in Betway Premiership
subtitle: The clash between the champions and the newcomers promises excitement
excerpt: Sundowns, already booked for the MTN8 final, will take on Milford, a side that has shown strength this season.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The showdown between Mamelodi Sundowns and Milford FC, scheduled for Wednesday night, is drawing attention because the former have already secured a spot in the MTN8 final while the latter have been surprising this season.

What changed in the Orlando Pirates match

Milford lost 2-0 to Orlando Pirates early in the campaign, but coach Dr. Xanti Pupuma points out that the side "kept the Pirates from scoring a second goal until stoppage time." The match saw the first goal in the 24th minute. Since then, Milford have remained unbeaten and sit in fifth place with seven points from four games.

Sundowns focused on MTN8 and the Betway Premiership

Malibongwe Khoza, Sundowns centre‑back, emphasizes that the squad "felt the pressure of reaching the MTN8 final" and that "the goal is to win the trophy they've been missing." The club is also concentrating on the clash with Milford, which could be decisive for qualification.

Expectations for the duel

Khoza describes Milford as "very energetic" and "dangerous on the counter‑attack." Sundowns' coach says the team is "ready for them and will give their all for the fans."

How Milford has stood out

With two wins in four games, Milford are proving they can compete with the league's veterans. Coach Pupuma believes the side "has the quality to create problems" if they maintain the same attitude.

Upcoming match schedule

  • Saturday: Chippa vs Milford, Nelson Mandela Bay, 3pm
  • Sunday: Arrows vs Sundowns, King Zwelithini Stadium, 3pm
  • Sunday: La Cure Sylvester vs Pirates, Cote d’Or National Sports Complex, Mauritius, 1.30pm

The Sundowns‑Milford duel will reveal whether the newcomers can keep surprising or if the champions will retain their dominance in the Betway Premiership.

Sources: iDiski Times, SABC Sport, TimesLIVE.
